name: What is involved in the exterior house painting process?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in the exterior house painting process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The exterior house painting process typically begins with thorough preparation, including power washing to clean surfaces, scraping loose paint, sanding rough areas, and repairing any cracks or holes. Next, surfaces are primed to ensure proper paint adhesion and a uniform finish. Two coats of high-quality exterior paint are then applied. Finally, a detailed cleanup is performed, and a final inspection ensures all work meets quality standards. This systematic approach ensures a long-lasting and aesthetically pleasing result.
acceptedAnswer.description: The exterior painting process involves cleaning, scraping, repairing, priming, applying two coats of paint, and a final cleanup and inspection.
